2842701b-a8e5-48fa-8a37-b487c4568714/Eve.en: Without further thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is momentarily stunned, standing still,<NL>but Yun'er, with a determined gaze, comes straight toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, and after a moment, stands before one, words failing...<NL><NL>"Senior sister! I finally found you..."
2842701b-a8e5-48fa-8a37-b487c4568714/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>未及多想，竟一时发愣，驻足不前，<NL>筠儿却目光灼灼，直向此处迎来，片刻之后，便行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眼前，欲语还休……<NL><NL>“师姐！我总算是找到你了……”

2842701b-a8e5-48fa-8a37-b487c4568714/Opt.en: It seems fate allows us to reunite...
2842701b-a8e5-48fa-8a37-b487c4568714/Opt.cn: 想来缘分既在，两人终能重逢……

8c695234-6ed1-4a39-9f1d-d398bf9100ff/Eve.en: A myriad of sights unfold before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes, as if in an illusion, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind in disarray.<NL>Taking a deep breath, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> steps forward, hearing the sound of celestial music lingering long...<NL><NL>"The sealed heart, moved by you...<NL>What is love, it turns out... you already know..."
8c695234-6ed1-4a39-9f1d-d398bf9100ff/Eve.cn: 万象森罗呈于眼前，犹如幻境中人，心乱如麻。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>深吸一口气，往前迈步，耳边却有天女之音，久久回响……<NL><NL>“尘封之心，竟受你牵动……<NL>情为何物，原来……你已然知晓……”

e1c04c56-33d3-4ff3-aea2-6da271895aef/Eve.en: In the Guqin room, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sits alone before the Guqin,<NL>although Yun'er is not around, her image emerges in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind...
e1c04c56-33d3-4ff3-aea2-6da271895aef/Eve.cn: 琴房之中，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>独坐琴前，<NL>虽不见筠儿，心中却浮现起筠儿身影……
e1c04c56-33d3-4ff3-aea2-6da271895aef/Eve.ru: В комнате Гуцинь, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> сидит в одиночестве перед Гуцинем,<NL>хотя Юньер нет рядом, ее образ возникает в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> разум...

e1c04c56-33d3-4ff3-aea2-6da271895aef/Opt.en: (The senior sister's mood has changed. It seems that after the lantern festival, things are different...)
e1c04c56-33d3-4ff3-aea2-6da271895aef/Opt.cn: （师姐心境有变，想来灯会之后，终有不同……）
e1c04c56-33d3-4ff3-aea2-6da271895aef/Opt.ru: (Настроение старшей сестры изменилось. Кажется, что после фестиваля фонарей все изменилось...)

f096977c-6efa-4be3-be4b-c58f6ecb2c9d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> reflects deeply.<NL>Since the trip to Dongting Lake and returning to the Jade-Maiden Sect,<NL>Yun'er seems to have had an overnight epiphany, no longer troubled by practicing music.<NL>Since their hearts are aligned, they are inseparable, playing the Guqin and spending their days and nights together,<NL>like mandarin ducks intertwined, in harmony...
f096977c-6efa-4be3-be4b-c58f6ecb2c9d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细细回忆，<NL>自从洞庭一游，再回璇女之后，<NL>筠儿似乎一夜顿悟，再不为修习音律所苦。<NL>二人既然心意相通，更是朝夕不离，抚琴弄弦，耳鬓厮磨，<NL>正恍若鸳鸯交颈，琴瑟和鸣……

f096977c-6efa-4be3-be4b-c58f6ecb2c9d/Opt.en: (It turns out Yun'er and the senior sister have opened their hearts to each other...)
f096977c-6efa-4be3-be4b-c58f6ecb2c9d/Opt.cn: （原来筠儿与师姐，已互诉衷肠……）
f096977c-6efa-4be3-be4b-c58f6ecb2c9d/Opt.ru: (Оказывается, Юнь эр и старшая сестра открыли свои сердца друг другу...)

5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Eve.en: However, the senior sister now sits alone quietly.<NL>Her own ominous prophecy, Yun'er's desire to ascend, and the ancient song of water sacrifice, all surge in her heart.<NL>Although everything seems well now, future misfortunes are unpredictable...
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Eve.cn: 然而师姐此时独自静坐，<NL>自己薄命之谶，筠儿登仙之愿，古曲祭水之言，<NL>桩桩件件一一涌上心头。只觉如今虽有百般好，来日祸事，却终是难预料……

5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.en: Yun'er intends to ascend, so how could I bear not to help her...
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.cn: 筠儿意在登仙，我如何忍心不助她……
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.ru: Юнь Эр намерена вознестись, так как же я мог не помочь ей?..

5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.en: If this life is fated to be short-lived, why not sacrifice myself to the water...
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.cn: 若此生注定薄命，我何妨以身祭水……
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.ru: Если этой жизни суждено быть недолгой, почему бы не принести себя в жертву воде?..

5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.en: If we cannot stay together forever, better to fulfill Yun'er's wishes...
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.cn: 终究不能相守，不如了却筠儿所愿……
5d78c6b2-e05c-4bed-96fb-ffb8a7bcc9e0/Opt.ru: Если мы не можем оставаться вместе вечно, лучше исполнить желание Юньэр...

d8c3fa8b-a238-404b-96f1-2d43ba93c33f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> concentrates deeply, a sense of unease arises.<NL>Although the senior sister is beset with many conflicting thoughts, ultimately, she only wishes to help Yun'er ascend.<NL>Her resolve is now as firm as rock, even if other thoughts arise within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, they do not sway her in the least...
d8c3fa8b-a238-404b-96f1-2d43ba93c33f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>凝神感应，暗叫不好，<NL>师姐虽有诸多杂念涌现，归根结底，仍只愿助筠儿登仙而去。<NL>此心如今坚如磐石，纵是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中另有别念，亦难以动摇分毫……

d8c3fa8b-a238-404b-96f1-2d43ba93c33f/Opt.en: (Could it be that the senior sister believes the ramblings of the disheveled man, and is determined to proceed...)
d8c3fa8b-a238-404b-96f1-2d43ba93c33f/Opt.cn: （师姐难道信了落魄人之胡言，执意如此……）
d8c3fa8b-a238-404b-96f1-2d43ba93c33f/Opt.ru: (Может ли быть так, что старшая сестра верит бредням взъерошенного мужчины и полна решимости продолжать...)

26e050bb-9368-4f1d-9c02-b5f168464604/Eve.en: While <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> reflects deeply, the scene before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> instantly turns dark!<NL>Specks of light flicker uncertainly,<NL>as if falling into the night sky, surrounded by fog and stars, the image of a Celestial Maiden slowly appears...
26e050bb-9368-4f1d-9c02-b5f168464604/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细想之际，眼前之景，<NL>又瞬息化为昏黑一片！点点辉光，闪烁不定，<NL>竟如同坠入夜空之中，四周雾气弥漫，星辰遍布，天女之影缓缓显现……

75c3ec1c-607f-4bee-9ece-a7d24b77d481/Eve.en: "Revisiting old matters... yet hard to turn around...<NL>You have seen the past situations, yet it seems there are more questions in your heart..."
75c3ec1c-607f-4bee-9ece-a7d24b77d481/Eve.cn: “旧事重提……却难转圜……<NL>你已见了昔日情形，心中却似有更多疑问……”
75c3ec1c-607f-4bee-9ece-a7d24b77d481/Eve.ru: - Возвращаюсь к старым делам... и все же трудно развернуться...<NL>Вы видели прошлые ситуации, но, похоже, в вашем сердце осталось еще больше вопросов..."

75c3ec1c-607f-4bee-9ece-a7d24b77d481/Opt.en: Is the senior sister's fate truly doomed? Could she really believe those baseless words...
75c3ec1c-607f-4bee-9ece-a7d24b77d481/Opt.cn: 师姐薄命之谶可是当真？她竟当真信了那无凭无据之言不成……
75c3ec1c-607f-4bee-9ece-a7d24b77d481/Opt.ru: Неужели судьба старшей сестры действительно предопределена? Могла ли она действительно поверить в эти безосновательные слова?..

45e65758-c10f-4960-9f94-e470930cad58/Eve.en: "When people know their fate prophecies, they often become obsessed, inadvertently fulfilling them.<NL>Unable to discern what is fate or human action, how can one truly judge what is real..."
45e65758-c10f-4960-9f94-e470930cad58/Eve.cn: “世人知晓谶言，常常心生偏执，反而主动应谶。<NL>既不能知何为天意，又不能知何为人力所致，到头来……又如何论虚实……”
45e65758-c10f-4960-9f94-e470930cad58/Eve.ru: "Когда люди знают пророчества о своей судьбе, они часто становятся одержимыми, непреднамеренно исполняя их.<NL>Неспособный различить, что такое судьба или человеческие поступки, как можно по-настоящему судить о том, что реально..."

c249b8e5-bf4c-460e-8283-e40e74ca4619/Eve.en: "If you knew the full prophecy,<NL>perhaps you could glimpse some divine secrets..."<NL>The Celestial Maiden speaks no more on this matter...
c249b8e5-bf4c-460e-8283-e40e74ca4619/Eve.cn: “若你知晓谶语全句，<NL>或许便可窥得几分天机……”<NL>话至此处，天女却是不再多言……
c249b8e5-bf4c-460e-8283-e40e74ca4619/Eve.ru: "Если бы ты знал полное пророчество,<NL>возможно, вы смогли бы заглянуть в какие-нибудь божественные Тайны..."<NL>Небесная Дева больше ничего не говорит по этому поводу...

c249b8e5-bf4c-460e-8283-e40e74ca4619/Opt.en: This makes sense. Having gone through this experience, I have also gained some insights...
c249b8e5-bf4c-460e-8283-e40e74ca4619/Opt.cn: 此言倒也有理，经此一历，我自然亦有所得……
c249b8e5-bf4c-460e-8283-e40e74ca4619/Opt.ru: В этом есть смысл. Пройдя через этот опыт, я также обрел некоторые озарения...

3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Eve.en: "So it is...<NL>Then do you now know why the senior sister throws herself into the water..."
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Eve.cn: “原来如此……<NL>那你此时，可是已知师姐何故投水……”
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Eve.ru: - Так оно и есть...<NL>Тогда теперь ты знаешь, почему старшая сестра бросилась в воду...

3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.en: The reasons why the senior sister jumped into the water remain unclear...
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.cn: 师姐究竟因何投水，尚且不明……
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.ru: Причины, по которым старшая сестра прыгнула в воду, остаются невыясненными...

3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.en: The senior sister may have been deceived by the prophecy, taking her own life...
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.cn: 师姐或受谶语所骗，投水自尽……
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.ru: Старшая сестра, возможно, была обманута пророчеством и покончила с собой...

3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.en: The senior sister might have a plan for Yun'er's ascension...
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.cn: 师姐或为筠儿登仙，有所图谋……
3ac92ded-e789-46ce-9a66-449e3211db21/Opt.ru: У старшей сестры, возможно, есть план восхождения Юньэр на престол...

741bc4e3-78dc-46d9-b1d8-812436dc553c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> reflects deeply on the illusion,<NL>that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees today.<NL>Although many signs have appeared, just as the Celestial Maiden said, without knowing the full prophecy, the truth remains elusive...<NL><NL>Hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s response, the Celestial Maiden neither nods nor shakes her head, but simply says,<NL>"You and I have not seen the truth... whether it is or isn't... no one knows..."
741bc4e3-78dc-46d9-b1d8-812436dc553c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细细沉思，<NL>今日所见幻境，虽已有了诸多迹象，<NL>然则正如天女所言，未知谶语全貌，仍是难知真相……<NL><NL>听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回答，天女却是既不点头，亦不摇头，只幽幽道：<NL>“你我未见真相……是与不是……无人知晓……”

741bc4e3-78dc-46d9-b1d8-812436dc553c/Opt.en: If I could re-enter the illusion, perhaps I would find more clues...
741bc4e3-78dc-46d9-b1d8-812436dc553c/Opt.cn: 若是还能再入幻境，或许便能知晓更多线索……
741bc4e3-78dc-46d9-b1d8-812436dc553c/Opt.ru: Если бы я мог снова войти в иллюзию, возможно, я нашел бы больше подсказок...

b389c331-ce2d-40aa-817f-916cb20ed5be/Eve.en: "The way of fate is spontaneous, it will come again...<NL>Since you have pressing matters to attend to, why not start your journey?<NL>When you return, perhaps you can revisit the illusion and explore further..."
b389c331-ce2d-40aa-817f-916cb20ed5be/Eve.cn: “缘法自在，终将再来……<NL>既然你有寻人要事在身，何不先启程而去？<NL>待你归来，或许便可再见幻境，一探究竟……”

a81be72d-aae2-4121-8074-2acc85f7ebd1/Eve.en: Deep in thought,<NL>the illusions <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees today, the words of the disheveled man seem to be etched in the senior sister's heart...<NL><NL>Hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s answer, the Celestial Maiden neither nods nor shakes her head, only murmuring softly,<NL>"We haven't seen the truth... whether it is or isn't... no one knows..."
a81be72d-aae2-4121-8074-2acc85f7ebd1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细细沉思，<NL>今日所见幻境，落魄人字字句句，似是皆被师姐记在心头……<NL><NL>听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回答，天女却是既不点头，亦不摇头，只幽幽道：<NL>“你我未见真相……是与不是……无人知晓……”

a8ea7ead-3ffa-49f5-b932-a491c613d840/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细细沉思，<NL>今日所见幻境，师姐心意之坚，实难忽视……<NL><NL>听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回答，天女却是既不点头，亦不摇头，只幽幽道：<NL>“你我未见真相……是与不是……无人知晓……”

0cb11464-10de-4da8-ad77-8358b93a9635/Eve.en: The Celestial Maiden continues,<NL>"The person you are seeking is now in <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> where time is of the essence; once you leave the mirror,<NL>you must set out immediately..."
0cb11464-10de-4da8-ad77-8358b93a9635/Eve.cn: 天女话至此处，忽而又道：<NL>“你欲寻之人，如今身在<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>，<NL>时间紧迫，只怕你离了镜中，便须立即上路……”

0cb11464-10de-4da8-ad77-8358b93a9635/Opt.en: Thank you, Celestial Maiden, for your guidance. I shall set out now...
0cb11464-10de-4da8-ad77-8358b93a9635/Opt.cn: 多谢天女指路，我这便出发……
0cb11464-10de-4da8-ad77-8358b93a9635/Opt.ru: Благодарю тебя, Небесная Дева, за твое руководство. А теперь я отправляюсь в путь...

aff9c403-bd7d-48de-bc56-1ddbcaecbcc7/Eve.en: The mist rises again, obscuring the sky, then suddenly disperses.<NL>All illusions vanish in an instant, and suddenly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> feels the chill of frost and a brush of thin snow on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> face.<NL>Coming back to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> senses, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finds <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>self standing before a clear mirror, the image of the Celestial Maiden no longer visible...
aff9c403-bd7d-48de-bc56-1ddbcaecbcc7/Eve.cn: 雾气再起，遮天蔽日，忽而又尽数消散。 <NL>种种幻境皆已消失，霎时间，便感风霜摧刮，薄雪拂面，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回过神来，原来自己已站在一明珏前，镜中空空，已再不见天女之影……

aff9c403-bd7d-48de-bc56-1ddbcaecbcc7/Opt.en: (Exiting the illusion feels like crossing into another world; best to quickly follow the Celestial Maiden's directions and search for the person...)
aff9c403-bd7d-48de-bc56-1ddbcaecbcc7/Opt.cn: （出得幻境，恍若隔世，还是速速依天女指引，前往寻人……）
aff9c403-bd7d-48de-bc56-1ddbcaecbcc7/Opt.ru: (Выход из иллюзии ощущается как переход в другой мир; лучше всего быстро следовать указаниям Небесной Девы и искать этого человека...)
